capabilities: Record focus time per note, canvas, and Excalidraw drawing with idle detection
Visualize the vault as a zoomable treemap heatmap colored by last visit, modification, or creation
Size heatmap tiles by visit time or file content size with linear, sqrt, or log scaling
Filter the heatmap by file path or text content
Inline a note into its single linking note, merging content, properties, and visit history
extras: Stores history as plain-text files in a hidden .plugin_data/visit_history/ folder, organized per user and per device; Obsidian Sync skips it so each device keeps its own history. Offers an API (API.md) for other plugins to read visit data. Roadmap lists journey visualization and nearby search as not yet built. Includes an appendix on restoring file timestamps after a git clone.
problem: Obsidian does not track which notes you actually spend time in or visualize vault activity over time.

relations.evidence: how long you focus on each note, canvas, and Excalidraw drawing

summary: Activity tracker that records focus time per note, canvas, and Excalidraw drawing, and shows the vault as a zoomable treemap heatmap.
